editorial.blurb: Pancho's Rooftop Cantina is a lively downtown spot famous for its Instagram-worthy soft serve margaritas and rooftop views, though quality and service can be inconsistent.
editorial.insiderTip: Go during happy hour for better-value margaritas (the soft serve margarita isn't included, but the regular margaritas offer great value). Arrive early to secure seating and note their strict 10-minute grace period on reservations.

topDishes.note: Flavorful highlight with perfect balance of crema, cotija cheese, paprika, and lime
Fun and Instagram-worthy, though tequila served separately affects consistency
